
            <h1 class="postTitle">
                <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/zys2019/p/19134886" title="发布于 2025-10-11 13:51">
    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">List之高效安全的 Java 列表深复制工具：ListCopyUtils 的设计与实践</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<div class="auto-hide-last-sibling-br paragraph-JOTKXA paragraph-element br-paragraph-space">在 Java 开发中，列表深复制是保障数据隔离的关键操作 —— 无论是多线程场景下的线程安全，还是避免原列表修改影响副本，都离不开可靠的深复制实现。基于序列化的深复制因通用性强被广泛使用，但原生实现常存在资源泄漏、类型不安全、异常处理粗糙等问题。本文将介绍一款优化后的列表深复制工具类<code>ListCopyUtils</code>，解决这些痛点，同时兼顾性能与易用性。</div>
<h2 class="header-vfC6AV auto-hide-last-sibling-br">一、为什么需要优化传统序列化深复制？</h2>
<div class="auto-hide-last-sibling-br paragraph-JOTKXA paragraph-element br-paragraph-space">传统的序列化深复制方法（如直接用<code>ObjectOutputStream</code>/<code>ObjectInputStream</code>）存在明显短板：</div>
<div class="container-utlnW2 md-box-line-break wrapper-d0Cc1k undefined">&nbsp;</div>
<ol class="auto-hide-last-sibling-br">
<li>资源管理隐患：流对象未用<code>try-with-resources</code>包裹，极端情况下导致 IO 资源泄漏；</li>
<li>类型安全缺失：盲目强制转换<code>(List&lt;T&gt;)</code>，若反序列化结果类型不匹配，会在调用方爆发隐藏的<code>ClassCastException</code>；</li>
<li>异常处理粗糙：捕获异常后直接返回空列表，无法区分 “原列表为空” 和 “复制失败”；</li>
<li>性能浪费：未预初始化列表容量，动态扩容增加额外开销；频繁创建空列表对象，浪费内存。</li>
</ol>
<div class="container-utlnW2 md-box-line-break wrapper-d0Cc1k undefined">&nbsp;</div>
<div class="auto-hide-last-sibling-br paragraph-JOTKXA paragraph-element br-paragraph-space"><code>ListCopyUtils</code>针对这些问题做了全方位优化，让深复制既安全又高效。</div>
<h2 class="header-vfC6AV auto-hide-last-sibling-br">二、ListCopyUtils 核心实现与优化点</h2>
<h3 class="header-vfC6AV auto-hide-last-sibling-br">1. 核心代码</h3>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">import org.slf4j.Logger;
import org.slf4j.LoggerFactory;
import java.io.</span>*<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.Collections;
import java.util.List;

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">/*</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">*
 * 列表深复制工具类：基于序列化，兼顾性能、安全与易用性
 </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">*/</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">class</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> ListCopyUtils {
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">private</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">static</span> final Logger log = LoggerFactory.getLogger(ListCopyUtils.<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">class</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 不可变空列表常量：避免重复创建空集合，减少内存浪费</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">private</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">static</span> final List&lt;?&gt; EMPTY_IMMUTABLE_LIST =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Collections.emptyList();

    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">/*</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">*
     * 标准深复制（抛出异常，适合需精细处理失败场景）
     * @param sourceList 源列表（元素必须实现Serializable）
     * @param elementType 元素Class（用于类型校验）
     * @param &lt;T&gt; 元素类型（需实现Serializable）
     * @return 深复制后的新列表
     * @throws IOException 序列化/反序列化失败时抛出
     </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">*/</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">static</span> &lt;T extends Serializable&gt; List&lt;T&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> deepCopyList(
            List</span>&lt;T&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> sourceList, 
            Class</span>&lt;T&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> elementType
    ) throws IOException {
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 空列表快速返回：避免无效IO操作</span>
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (sourceList == <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">null</span> ||<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> sourceList.isEmpty()) {
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> (List&lt;T&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">) EMPTY_IMMUTABLE_LIST;
        }

        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> try-with-resources自动关闭流：杜绝资源泄漏</span>
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">try</span> (ByteArrayOutputStream bos = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> ByteArrayOutputStream();
             ObjectOutputStream oos </span>= <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> ObjectOutputStream(bos)) {
            
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 序列化：强制刷新缓冲区，确保数据完整</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">            oos.writeObject(sourceList);
            oos.flush();

            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 反序列化：二次校验类型，提前暴露问题</span>
            <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">try</span> (ByteArrayInputStream bis = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> ByteArrayInputStream(bos.toByteArray());
                 ObjectInputStream ois </span>= <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> ObjectInputStream(bis)) {

                Object deserialized </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> ois.readObject();
                </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 一级校验：是否为List类型</span>
                <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (!<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">(deserialized instanceof List)) {
                    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">throw</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> ClassCastException(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">反序列化结果非List类型</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
                }

                List</span>&lt;?&gt; rawList = (List&lt;?&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">) deserialized;
                </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 预初始化容量：避免动态扩容，提升性能</span>
                List&lt;T&gt; resultList = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> ArrayList&lt;&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">(rawList.size());

                </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 二级校验：逐个元素类型匹配（确保泛型安全）</span>
                <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">for</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> (Object element : rawList) {
                    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (element == <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">null</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">) {
                        resultList.add(</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">null</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
                        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">continue</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
                    }
                    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (!<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">elementType.isInstance(element)) {
                        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">throw</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> ClassCastException(
                            String.format(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">元素类型不匹配：期望%s，实际%s</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
                                elementType.getName(), element.getClass().getName())
                        );
                    }
                    resultList.add(elementType.cast(element));
                }
                </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> resultList;
            } </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">catch</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> (ClassNotFoundException e) {
                log.error(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">反序列化失败：类定义缺失</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, e);
                </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">throw</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> IOException(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">深复制失败：类版本不兼容</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, e);
            }
        }
    }

    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">/*</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">*
     * 安全深复制（不抛受检异常，适合快速使用场景）
     * @param sourceList 源列表
     * @param elementType 元素Class
     * @param &lt;T&gt; 元素类型
     * @return 复制结果（失败时返回空列表，避免NPE）
     </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">*/</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">static</span> &lt;T extends Serializable&gt; List&lt;T&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> safeDeepCopyList(
            List</span>&lt;T&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> sourceList, 
            Class</span>&lt;T&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> elementType
    ) {
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">try</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> {
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> deepCopyList(sourceList, elementType);
        } </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">catch</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> (IOException e) {
            log.error(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">列表深复制失败</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, e);
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> ArrayList&lt;&gt;(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span>); <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 返回空列表而非null，降低调用方风险</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">        }
    }
}</span></pre>
</div>
<h3 class="header-vfC6AV auto-hide-last-sibling-br">2. 关键优化点解析</h3>
<div class="auto-hide-last-sibling-br mdbox-table-root table-container-GhL7Lo" data-scroll-inline-overflow="true" data-scroll-inline-at-start="true" data-scroll-inline-start-overflow="false" data-scroll-inline-at-end="false" data-scroll-inline-end-overflow="true">
<div class="table-scroll-container-hgHkfW mdbox-table-scroll-container">
<table>
<thead>
<tr><th>优化方向</th><th>具体实现</th><th>解决的问题</th></tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td>资源安全</td>
<td>用<code>try-with-resources</code>自动关闭流</td>
<td>避免 IO 资源泄漏，无需手动 close</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>类型安全</td>
<td>新增<code>elementType</code>参数，两级类型校验（List 校验 + 元素校验）</td>
<td>提前暴露类型不匹配问题，避免隐藏的<code>ClassCastException</code></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>性能优化</td>
<td>1. 预初始化列表容量（<code>new ArrayList&lt;&gt;(rawList.size())</code>）
<div class="container-utlnW2 md-box-line-break wrapper-d0Cc1k undefined">&nbsp;</div>
2. 空列表返回不可变常量</td>
<td>减少动态扩容开销；避免重复创建空对象</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>异常处理</td>
<td>1. 标准方法抛出<code>IOException</code>，保留失败详情
<div class="container-utlnW2 md-box-line-break wrapper-d0Cc1k undefined">&nbsp;</div>
2. 安全方法封装异常，返回空列表</td>
<td>兼顾 “精细处理” 和 “快速使用” 场景，避免 NPE</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>易用性</td>
<td>提供两个重载方法，适配不同异常处理需求</td>
<td>无需调用方重复编写异常逻辑</td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
</div>
</div>
<h2 class="header-vfC6AV auto-hide-last-sibling-br">三、使用示例</h2>
<h3 class="header-vfC6AV auto-hide-last-sibling-br">1. 依赖前提</h3>
<p>列表元素必须实现<code>Serializable</code>接口（序列化深复制的基础要求），示例元素类：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 实现Serializable接口的用户类</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public class</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> User implements Serializable {
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">private</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> String name;
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">private</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Integer age;
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 构造器、getter、setter省略</span>
}</pre>
</div>
<h3 class="header-vfC6AV auto-hide-last-sibling-br">2. 标准使用（精细处理失败场景）</h3>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 源列表数据</span>
List&lt;User&gt; originalList = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> ArrayList&lt;&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">();
originalList.add(</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> User(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">张三</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">25</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">));
originalList.add(</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> User(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">李四</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">30</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">));

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">try</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> {
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 深复制（需处理IOException）</span>
    List&lt;User&gt; copyList = ListCopyUtils.deepCopyList(originalList, User.<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">class</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 修改副本，原列表不受影响</span>
    copyList.<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">get</span>(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span>).setName(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">张三-副本</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
    System.</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">out</span>.println(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">原列表第一个元素：</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span> + originalList.<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">get</span>(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span>).getName()); <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 输出“张三”</span>
} <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">catch</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> (IOException e) {
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 处理复制失败（如重试、提示用户）</span>
    System.err.println(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">复制失败：</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span> +<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> e.getMessage());
}</span></pre>
</div>
<h3 class="header-vfC6AV auto-hide-last-sibling-br">3. 简化使用（快速集成场景）</h3>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 无需处理异常，失败时返回空列表</span>
List&lt;User&gt; safeCopyList = ListCopyUtils.safeDeepCopyList(originalList, User.<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">class</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> (safeCopyList.isEmpty()) {
    System.</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">out</span>.println(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">复制失败或源列表为空</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
} </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">else</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> {
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 业务处理</span>
}</pre>
</div>
<h2 class="header-vfC6AV auto-hide-last-sibling-br">四、注意事项</h2>
<ol class="auto-hide-last-sibling-br">
<li>元素序列化要求：元素类必须实现<code>Serializable</code>，且非静态内部类需避免（可能因外部类引用导致序列化失败）；</li>
<li>transient 字段：元素类中用<code>transient</code>修饰的字段不会被复制（序列化特性），需提前确认需求；</li>
<li>类版本兼容性：若元素类结构变更（如增减字段），需保持<code>serialVersionUID</code>一致，避免反序列化失败。</li>
</ol>
<h2 class="header-vfC6AV auto-hide-last-sibling-br">五、总结</h2>
<div class="auto-hide-last-sibling-br paragraph-JOTKXA paragraph-element br-paragraph-space"><code>ListCopyUtils</code>通过 “资源安全 + 类型安全 + 性能优化 + 易用性设计”，解决了传统序列化深复制的痛点。无论是多线程数据隔离、批量数据处理，还是接口返回数据保护，都能通过该工具快速实现可靠的列表深复制，同时降低代码冗余和潜在风险。</div>
</div>
